newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock index down 1.01 pct in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock index down 1.01 pct in late trading.

text.p: The Jakarta stock composite index fell 1.01 percent to 691.32 points in late trading on Wednesday due to profit-taking, particularly in blue-chip Telkom, before recovering slightly, brokers said.
The index was down 4.86, or 0.70 percent, at 693.54 points at the close.
"It seems to be a profit-taking session now, but we had expected the index to fall as the recent gains were too strong and too fast," one broker said.
Brokers said worries of post-election disturbances and reports of a bomb threat on the Japanese embassy on Wednesday also helped dampen sentiment.
Blue chips Telkom fell 100 rupiah to 4,000 rupiah, Semen Gresik SMGR.JK. down 125 rupiah at 5,500 rupiah and Gudang Garam GGRM.JK fell 100 rupiah to 10,475 rupiah.
